currency_handling.rule: All Pancake monetary fields store values in bani (1/100). Divide by 100 at ETL.

revenue_recognition.rule: Revenue = cod ÷ 100, ONLY for orders with status IN (3, 16)
revenue_recognition.partial_return_rule: Partial revenue — needs returned_count per item to calculate net revenue
revenue_recognition.excluded_reason: Status 7 = deleted orders, must be excluded from ALL financial calculations

pnl_formula.cogs: SUM(quantity × avg_imported_price ÷ 100) FROM order_items WHERE NOT is_bonus_product

reconciliation.rule: Compare order.cod vs partner.cod for each shipped/delivered order
reconciliation.alert_threshold: gap > 0 or gap < 0 indicates COD discrepancy

sources.prepaid: cash + transfer_money (customer already paid before delivery)

payment_methods.cod: Cash on Delivery — collected by carrier
payment_methods.money_to_collect: Outstanding amount still to be collected

cash_flow_forecasting.formula: Expected Cash In (Date T) = SUM(cod) where delivered_date = T - cod_cycle_days
cash_flow_forecasting.hold_time_impact: Providers hold COD for X days before remittance. Must subtract hold days from liquidity.

schema_review_checklist: All monetary fields are FLOAT64 (not INT — already ÷100)
revenue uses cod, NOT total_price (cod = actual money collected)
total_price is GMV (pre-discount) — for discount analysis only
return_fee only counted for returned orders (status 4,5,15)
payment method fields (cash, transfer_money, vnpay, momo, card) all present
Status 7 (deleted) excluded from all financial views
Partitioned by order_date for cost efficiency
